qs.q: A term newborn required bag‑mask ventilation for 3 minutes and had a 1‑minute Apgar of 3 and a 5‑minute Apgar of 4. After stabilization the infant is lethargic, has hypotonia and a weak suck. Which classification best describes his neurological status?
qs.e: Lethargy, hypotonia and weak suck are features of moderate (Stage II) HIE. Stage I would have normal tone and Stage III would be flaccid with absent suck.
